# Open Design Docs

> Free, open-source design career resources for product designers, UX designers, and design managers. Comprehensive frameworks for career development, team building, and design leadership.

## About

Open Design Docs provides practical, actionable resources to help design professionals grow their careers and design managers build effective teams. All content is free and open-source.

Website: https://opendesigndocs.com
Created by: Jason Culbertson (https://linkedin.com/in/jasonculbertson)

- [Performance Reviews](/docs/levels/reviews): Performance review frameworks and self-evaluation guides

## Design Role Hierarchy

The standard design career ladder used throughout this site:

| Level | Title | Experience |
|-------|-------|------------|
| L1 | Designer 1 / Junior | 0-2 years |
| L2 | Designer 2 | 2-4 years |
| L3 | Senior Designer | 4-6 years |
| L4 | Staff Designer | 6-8 years |
| L5 | Lead Designer | 8-10 years |
| L6 | Principal Designer | 10+ years |

## Key Concepts

- **IC (Individual Contributor)**: Designers who don't manage people but contribute through their craft
- **Design Ladder**: Career progression framework from entry-level to principal
- **Competency Matrix**: Skills and behaviors expected at each career level
- **Interview Panels**: Structured interview processes with multiple evaluators
- **Performance Reviews**: Regular assessment and feedback cycles
